The team played its home games on [[Ed Jucker]] Court at the [[Fifth Third Arena]]. They finished the season 27–7, 15–3 in AAC play to share the regular season conference title with Louisville. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2014 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] where they lost to UConn.
